UrbanLeads by UrbanBuying

Organic lead generation for small businesses

Small businesses can build visibility by publishing helpful, specific information, answering customer questions and keeping enquiries organised. UrbanLeads provides tools to plan that work without requiring paid advertising as the only channel.

Publish useful, relevant content

Plan product information, service explainers, FAQs, seasonal posts and local updates that answer real customer questions.

Capture and organise enquiries

Keep actual enquiries in a CRM workflow, update their status and plan follow-up. Never treat a search signal or content draft as an actual enquiry.

Measure and improve

Track real enquiries and marketing activity, refine content topics and use Search Console when available to monitor impressions, clicks and indexing.
